author: Bellular News
description:
Xbox’s latest cuts reveal far more than another round of layoffs. With 3,200 jobs gone and four studios released, Microsoft is narrowing Xbox around its biggest franchises, cheaper production and one final hardware bet.

We trace how far Game Pass fell short of Microsoft’s ambitions, which studios and projects no longer fit the plan, why experienced developers and critical platform knowledge were cut, and how much now rests on Project Helix.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
